description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945015319587 RELAY,MOTOR DRIVEN: Line 0001 Qty 176 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0126 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
